text:
Maya (CS): drafting a compact customer-facing runbook for go-live: prefill/prefetch, small-batch defaults, streaming fallback. want it to be one page + 3 tiny drop-in snippets. any red flags?
Diego (FieldOps): start with jittered prefill schedules and conservative batch_size (2-8). too many customers set batch_size too high and see latency spikes.
Rina (SRE): include a clear fallback order: 1) retry streaming with backoff, 2) fall back to non-streaming gen on same model, 3) route to fallback_model if latency SLA breached. add max_latency_ms per route.
Alex (CSM): add renewal-risk signals mapping: first-week timeouts -> high risk; repeated degraded outputs -> medium; successful steady ops -> low. simple table for CSMs to prioritize.
OnboardBot: note: attach sample onboarding dashboard -> https://console.redwood/onboard/example
Maya (CS): quick snippet ideas: prefetch warm KV, tiny adaptive batcher, streaming fallback. keep each <=12 lines.
Diego (FieldOps): prefill TTL idea: conv contexts = 45-90s, assistant profiles = 4-8min, add random jitter +/-15-25%.
Rina (SRE): python prefetch pseudo:
```
# warm KV prefetch
if not cache.has(key):
  resp = model.call(prefix, max_tokens=0)
  cache.set(key, resp.kv_head, ttl=int(base_ttl * random.uniform(0.8,1.2)))
```
Maya (CS): batching example (adapt down if p95 > target):
```
# tiny batcher
batch.add(req)
if batch.size >= 4 or elapsed > 0.02:
  send(batch)
  if p95_latency > goal: batch.size = max(1, batch.size-1)
```
Rina (SRE): fallback snippet idea (pseudoconfig JSON):
```
{"route":"/chat","fallback_model":"gptx-lite","max_latency_ms":1200}
```
Alex (CSM): for the runbook include: one-line summary, quick checklist (flags to flip), when to escalate to CS/SE, and a customer feedback form link. non-technical language for PMs.
Diego (FieldOps): ops tip: schedule staged warmups (10m, 30m, 60m) before big launches. also provide a tiny cron script sample to trigger prefill.
Maya (CS): good. action items: Alex -> risk mapping + feedback form by Wed EOD; Rina -> telemetry keys & sample prometheus queries; Diego -> warmup cron script + jitter recommendations; I'll assemble the one-pager and share for review. :thumbsup:
OnboardBot: reminder set: send 72h post-go-live checklist to customer.
Alex (CSM): will review draft and add CSM copy for the email.
Rina (SRE): will paste prometheus queries after draft review.
Maya (CS): thanks team, aiming to ship customer PDF + inline email snippets tomorrow.
